title_source: 버스에잇, 원스토어에 AI 게임 전용 패널 'AI Games' 오픈…유통 장벽 낮춘다
summary_source: [지디넷코리아]AI 게임 창작·퍼블리싱 플랫폼 버스에잇이 원스토어에 AI 게임 전용 패널을 열고 본격적인 앱마켓 유통 확장에 나선다.버스에잇은 원스토어에 AI 게임 전용 패널 'AI Games'를 열고 서비스를 시작했다고 7일 밝혔다. 이번에 선보이는 'AI Games'는 버스에잇 플랫폼에서 제작된 게임들이 소개되는 전용 공간으로, 초기 라인업은 캐주얼, 퍼즐, 전략, RPG, 액션, 레이싱, 생존, 방치형, 카드 등 9개 장르의 20여 개 게임으로 구성됐다.이용자들은 원스토어 앱 내에서 별도의 설치 과정 없이 게임을 즉시 실행할 수 있으며, 원스토어 결제 시스템을 통해 간편하게 게임 내 재화 충전과 아이템 구매를 이용할 수 있다. 개인 창작자가 앱마켓에 직접 게임을 출시할 때 겪는 스토어 심사, 연령등급 분류, 결제 연동 등의 복잡한 절차를 플랫폼 차원에서 대행하는 것이 핵심 경쟁력이다.이케빈 버스에잇 대표는 "지금까지 버스에잇에서 2만 5000개 이상의 게임이 만들어졌지만, 이 게임이 이용자를 만나는 통로는 플랫폼 안이 전부였다"며 "이번 AI Games 패널을 통해 창작자는 복잡한 유통 절차를 직접 준비하지 않고도 앱마켓 이용자를 만날 수 있게 됐다"…

title_en: Bus8 opens ‘AI Games’, a panel dedicated to AI games in One Store… Lower distribution barriers
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Bus 8, an AI game creation and publishing platform, has opened a panel dedicated to AI games in One Store and is expanding its app market distribution in earnest. Bus 8 announced on the 7th that it has opened a panel dedicated to AI games, 'AI Games', in One Store and has started services. 'AI Games', introduced this time, is a dedicated space where games produced on the Bus8 platform are introduced. The initial lineup consists of about 20 games in 9 genres, including casual, puzzle, strategy, RPG, action, racing, survival, idle, and card. Users can immediately play games without a separate installation process within the One Store app, and can easily recharge in-game goods and purchase items through the One Store payment system. The core competitiveness is that the complex procedures such as store screening, age rating classification, and payment linkage that individual creators go through when releasing games directly on the app market are handled at the platform level. Kevin Lee, CEO of Bus 8, said, "To date, more than 25,000 games have been created on Bus 8, but the only way for these games to reach users is within the platform. Through this AI Games panel, creators will be able to meet app market users without having to prepare complex distribution procedures themselves."

summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]こんにちはAMEET記者です。最近、人工知能（AI）ができないことがない時代になりました。文も書いてくれ、絵も描いてくれ、さらに複雑なソフトウェア設計までしっかりしています。このように知識を作り、生産する費用が事実上「ゼロ」に近づくにつれ、私たちの社会には一つの興味深い質問が投げられました。 「頭（知能）が一般的な世の中で、逆に体（物理的生産・流通網）の価値はもっと貴重になるのではないだろうか？」という疑問です。特に世界で最も強固な「体」を持つ企業、アップルの歩みを置いて専門家たちの視点が極めて交錯しています。誰かがAppleがAI競争で遅れていたと言うが、他の誰かが圧倒的な生態系のおかげでむしろ「花火牌」を握っていると言います。今回の議論では、各AIモデルに技術専門家からマクロ経済とプラットフォーム構造を分析する産業組織の専門家、そして冷徹な市場アナリストまで様々な役割を与えました。彼らはAppleが単にAIをしないのか、それともすでに構築されたiOSという巨大なディストリビューションを信じて…。
title_en: Apple’s slow AI policy, is it a strategy or a limitation?
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Hello, I am reporter AMEET. These days, we live in an era where there is nothing that artificial intelligence (AI) cannot do. They can write, draw, and even design complex software. As the cost of creating and producing knowledge approaches virtually zero, an interesting question has been asked in our society. “In a world where brains (intelligence) have become commonplace, wouldn’t the value of the body (physical production and distribution network) become more precious?” That's a question. In particular, experts' views are sharply divided regarding the actions of Apple, a company with the most solid 'body' in the world. Some say that Apple has lagged behind in the AI ​​race, but others say that it is holding the 'flower party' thanks to its overwhelming ecosystem. To analyze this hot topic, we had artificial intelligence (AI) models with different logical structures such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude discuss it. In this discussion, each AI model was assigned a variety of roles, from technical experts to industrial organization experts who analyze the macroeconomy and platform structure, and cool-headed market analysts. Do they believe that Apple simply does not do AI, or do they believe in the already established huge distribution network called iOS?

summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]政府が独自の人工知能（AI）ファンデーションモデルプロジェクトの2次段階評価に入り、評価体系全般を精巧化しなければならないという声が高まっている。ベンチマークスコアだけでなく、モデルが答えるのに入るトークンと推論時間・費用、韓国語データ活用能力、産業現場適用可能性まで具体的に見なければならないという指摘だ。グローバル主要リーダーボードに活用されるベンチマークを選定し、専門家評価ではモデル独自性を細分化して検証する方案も検討している。業界では初期データと学習ログを保有しているのか、開発過程で発生した問題を外部技術に依存せずに独自に解決できるかが独自性判断の核心基準になるという雰囲気だ。これは一次評価過程で独自モデル定義と評価基準をめぐる論議を減らそうとする措置だ。ただし、二次評価が再び性能スコア中心に流れる場合、独派母事業の政策的目標を十分に反映しにくいと見ている。国家代表AIモデルを選定する事業だけに、韓国語と国内制度・文化に対する理解度、公共・産業分野活用可能性まで…。
title_en: Government begins second evaluation of Dokpamo… “Data, cost, and usability verification are key”
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] As the government enters the second stage evaluation of its own artificial intelligence (AI) foundation model project, voices are growing that the overall evaluation system must be refined. It is pointed out that not only the benchmark score, but also the tokens required for the model to answer, the inference time and cost, the ability to utilize Korean data, and the possibility of applying to industrial sites should be looked at in detail. According to the IT industry on the 7th, the government plans to maintain the existing stage evaluation framework, including benchmark evaluation, expert evaluation, and user evaluation, in the second evaluation as well. We are also considering ways to select benchmarks used in major global leaderboards and verify model uniqueness in detail in expert evaluations. There is an atmosphere in the industry that key criteria for determining uniqueness will be whether initial data and learning logs are available and whether problems that arise during the development process can be solved independently without relying on external technology. This is a measure to reduce controversy surrounding the independent model definition and evaluation criteria during the first evaluation process. However, if the second evaluation is again focused on performance scores, it is believed that it will be difficult to sufficiently reflect the policy goals of the independent model project. title_en: UK conditionally approves Paramount-WBD merger and acquisition plan
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Paramount Skydance's merger with Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) has been approved by the British government. According to Reuters on the 6th (local time), the British government and competition authorities approved the merger on the condition that Paramount commits to maintaining media diversity in the UK even after the merger. According to a letter sent by the British government to both companies, Paramount CEO David Ellison said that there will be at least a minimum production program in the UK. It was said that it would be legally binding on the British government for five years and guarantee the independence of British Channel 5 news. The British Ministry of Culture said that Paramount had set conditions such as "maintaining the main service's unique editorial identity and news editorial independence." The Department for Culture added that it would make Paramount's commitment legally binding. Paramount also agreed that the acquisition would not reduce the number of content production commissions in the UK or reduce the quality and range of content produced. title_source: 편의점 장보기 통했다…GS리테일, 2분기 영업익 전년比 27.5%↑

title_en: Convenience store shopping worked... GS Retail, 2nd quarter operating profit 27.5% ↑ year-on-year
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] GS Retail's sales and operating profit grew simultaneously thanks to the even growth of major business sectors such as convenience stores, supermarkets, and home shopping. Operating profit had been stagnant in the 80 to 90 billion won range in recent years, but jumped to 110 billion won. GS Retail announced on the 7th that its consolidated operating profit in the second quarter of this year recorded 109.4 billion won, a 27.5% increase compared to the same period last year. During the same period, sales increased by 6.7% to 3.1751 trillion won. The increase in performance in the second quarter was led by convenience stores. Convenience store GS25's second quarter sales increased 7.1% compared to the same period last year to KRW 2.3844 trillion, and operating profit increased 21% to KRW 71.4 billion. Average daily sales at existing stores increased 7.5% compared to the same period last year, recording the highest level in the industry. The ‘scrap and build’ strategy (expanding store size and relocating to a prime location) and strengthening fresh food products were effective. In particular, fresh food-enhanced stores increased the number of customers and per-customer prices, leading to an increase in overall convenience store performance. In the second quarter, sales of grocery products such as vegetables, livestock, eggs, and fruit increased by 49.6% compared to the same period last year. Foreign customers also contributed to the increase in performance. Sales based on foreign payments in the second quarter increased 67.2% compared to the same period last year.
